decisions.reason: Because it survived the first post-launch years while several sibling launches were removed, and because this adjacent component fits the firm's broad heat-exchanger portfolio in a growing, R&D-active firm with some slack, it likely met at least minimum aspirations and is more likely to be retained.

As an incremental, capability-based tube innovation closely tied to the firm's engineering and service strengths, it appears more consistent with aspiration-meeting performance than the products dropped earlier, so management would likely keep it unless clearer signs of underperformance emerge.
